metadata.name: Klondike Draw 3
metadata.description: Single-player Klondike solitaire with a draw-three stock.

actions.name: DrawThree
actions.predicate: source.label = D1 and destination.label = C1 and source.count >= 3 and count = 3

actions.name: DrawRemainingCards
actions.predicate: source.label = D1 and destination.label = C1 and source.count > 0 and source.count < 3 and count = source.count

actions.name: RecycleWaste
actions.predicate: source.label = C1 and destination.label = D1 and D1.count = 0 and C1.count > 0 and count = source.count

actions.name: FlipTableauCard
actions.predicate: source.type = Tableau and source.visibility = Hidden and destination.type = Tableau and destination.visibility = Public and source.column = destination.column and source.count > 0 and destination.count = 0

actions.name: TableauToEmptyTableau
actions.predicate: source.type = Tableau and source.visibility = Public and destination.type = Tableau and destination.visibility = Public and source.column != destination.column and source.count > 0 and destination.count = 0 and count > 0 and count <= source.count and source.cardFromTop(count).rank = 13

actions.name: TableauToTableau
actions.predicate: source.type = Tableau and source.visibility = Public and destination.type = Tableau and destination.visibility = Public and source.column != destination.column and source.count > 0 and destination.count > 0 and count > 0 and count <= source.count and source.cardFromTop(count).rank + 1 = destination.top.rank and source.cardFromTop(count).color != destination.top.color

actions.name: WasteToEmptyTableau
actions.predicate: source.type = Discard and source.visibility = Public and destination.type = Tableau and destination.visibility = Public and source.count > 0 and destination.count = 0 and source.top.rank = 13 and count = 1

actions.name: WasteToTableau
actions.predicate: source.type = Discard and source.visibility = Public and destination.type = Tableau and destination.visibility = Public and source.count > 0 and destination.count > 0 and source.top.rank + 1 = destination.top.rank and source.top.color != destination.top.color and count = 1

actions.name: FoundationToEmptyTableau
actions.predicate: source.type = Foundation and destination.type = Tableau and destination.visibility = Public and source.count > 0 and destination.count = 0 and source.top.rank = 13 and count = 1

actions.name: FoundationToTableau
actions.predicate: source.type = Foundation and destination.type = Tableau and destination.visibility = Public and source.count > 0 and destination.count > 0 and source.top.rank + 1 = destination.top.rank and source.top.color != destination.top.color and count = 1

actions.name: AceToFoundation
actions.predicate: source.type in [Tableau, Discard] and source.visibility = Public and destination.type = Foundation and destination.count = 0 and source.count > 0 and source.top.rank = 1 and source.top.suit = destination.suit and count = 1

actions.name: BuildFoundation
actions.predicate: source.type in [Tableau, Discard] and source.visibility = Public and destination.type = Foundation and source.count > 0 and destination.count > 0 and source.top.suit = destination.suit and source.top.rank = destination.top.rank + 1 and count = 1

completion.predicate: F1-Hearts.count = 13 and F1-Diamonds.count = 13 and F1-Clubs.count = 13 and F1-Spades.count = 13
